verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents remotely toggling features on and off without deploying new code, so a kill switch exists in principle. The pack never says how fast changes reach connected SDKs. A community comment notes Flagsmith primarily evaluates flags server-side, which hints changes may show up on the next fetch, but it gives no latency figure. Missing for 10: any documented streaming/real-time update channel, documented polling intervals or propagation latency, SDK refresh behaviour, and hands-on evidence that a kill switch takes effect within seconds.
